open_points.subject: R0-04 prototype policy
open_points.text: “Withdrawn: the layers are not filled through a prototype” / “The decision of 2026-11-18 to fill each layer through a running prototype is withdrawn.”
open_points.question: Are later layers prohibited from using a prototype, or is the former requirement merely withdrawn so that a prototype remains optional?
options: Prototypes are prohibited when filling later layers.
Prototypes are optional; only the requirement to use one was withdrawn.
open_points.default_guess: Treat prototypes as optional because the body withdraws the mandate without forbidding their use.

witness.initial: A later layer contains an unresolved behavior that a small prototype could test.
events: The later-layer author reads the R0-04 title and omits the prototype as prohibited.
Another careful author reads the R0-04 body and runs the prototype because only the mandate was withdrawn.
outcomes: The layer is written solely from prior layers and owner decisions.
The layer also uses observations from a prototype to resolve the behavior.
witness.observer: The owner or reviewer sees different claims and supporting artifacts in the completed layer.
